code_mode.description:
Lets AI agents write code that uses their tools, instead of calling the tools one by one.

An agent can then combine many tool calls in one step, and tool results that the agent does not need stay out of the conversation. The code runs in a sandbox that can only call the tools of the agent.

Small models can give worse results with this feature.
code_mode.disable_confirmation: AI agents will call their tools one by one again.
code_mode.enable_confirmation: This feature is still in development and may change. AI agents will run code in a sandbox to use their tools.
code_mode.name: Code mode for AI agents
